title: PRISM: Reducing Spurious Implicit Biases in Vision-Language Models with LLM-Guided Embedding Projection
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical solution for mitigating 'spurious correlations' in vision-language models, such as associations between objects and their backgrounds. While it mentions social bias and fairness as motivations, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
